title.purpose: The page noun, once per screen.

figure.purpose: The one number that answers the screen's question.

section.purpose: Sits outside its card, 8px above it.

id.purpose: Receipts, TIDs, links and template tokens only.

shadows.name: segment-lift
shadows.purpose: The selected option inside a segmented control.

shadows.name: step-now
shadows.purpose: Underline on the step in hand.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover and selection colour changes; nothing performs an entrance.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Admin tables become stacked rows below it; small buttons grow to 44px.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: The frame and sidebar appear at and above it.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Near-black pill; the screen's one main action.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid transparent; background:oklch(14.5% 0.004 265); color:oklch(99.4% 0.001 265); font:500 15px/1 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .16s, transform .16s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:oklch(32% 0.006 265); } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(14.5% 0.004 265); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White outlined pill for every row action.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:36px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid oklch(86% 0.005 85); background:#fff; color:oklch(14.5% 0.004 265); font:500 14px/1 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .16s; } .ds-btn2:hover { background:oklch(94.2% 0.005 85); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(14.5% 0.004 265); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; font:500 14px/1.3 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color:oklch(14.5% 0.004 265); } .ds-field input { min-height:44px; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid oklch(86% 0.005 85); background:#fff; font:400 16px Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:oklch(54% 0.006 265); } .ds-field input:focus { outline:none; border-color:oklch(14.5% 0.004 265); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px oklch(14.5% 0.004 265 / .08); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Pale wash, dark text of the same hue; one per row.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:22px; padding:0 9px; border-radius:999px; font:500 12px/1 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pill-notice { background:oklch(97.6% 0.035 92); color:oklch(42% 0.1 60); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(91% 0.09 92); } .ds-pill-pos { background:oklch(96% 0.04 155); color:oklch(30% 0.07 155); }

components.name: Panel
components.html:
Customers sent to Google

81
components.css: .ds-panel { padding:20px; border-radius:14px; border:1px solid oklch(91.8% 0.004 85); background:#fff; font-family:Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-k { margin:0; font-size:14px; color:oklch(47% 0.006 265); } .ds-v { margin:4px 0 0; font:600 32px/40px Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.02em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Nav Row
components.description: Sidebar rows on the frame; the active one a quiet tone step.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; gap:2px; width:208px; padding:8px; background:oklch(96.6% 0.0035 85); font:400 14px Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; min-height:36px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:8px; color:oklch(47% 0.006 265); cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav a:hover { background:oklch(94.2% 0.005 85); color:oklch(14.5% 0.004 265); } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { background:oklch(92.6% 0.006 85); color:oklch(14.5% 0.004 265); font-weight:500; } .ds-nav b { min-width:20px; height:20px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:999px; background:oklch(14.5% 0.004 265); color:#fff; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; }

components.name: Step Track
components.description: Where a process stands: Done, Now, Next.
components.html:
✓ DonePlan paid
2 NowAdd your Google link
3 NextStand & card
components.css: .ds-track { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); border:1px solid oklch(91.8% 0.004 85); border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; background:#fff; font-family:Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-track div { padding:14px 18px; } .ds-track div + div { border-left:1px solid oklch(91.8% 0.004 85); } .ds-track i { display:block; font:500 12px Geist, sans-serif; color:oklch(47% 0.006 265); } .ds-track i.ok { color:oklch(50% 0.11 155); } .ds-track .now { box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 oklch(81% 0.165 76); } .ds-track .now i { color:oklch(52% 0.13 62); } .ds-track b { display:block; margin-top:6px; font-weight:500; font-size:15px; }

narrative.overview: An owner glances between customers; the team checks payments over tea. Each screen answers one question in five seconds and offers the action that follows. A warm stone frame holds a white sheet; ink does the talking, and amber appears only where a customer went to Google or a step is in hand.
keyCharacteristics: Tinted L-frame around a white sheet, no shadows
Colour on data, not chrome: under 3% of pixels
Figures as type with tabular numerals, never tiles
Honest zeros, dashes for missing, demo data labelled

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Amber marks the Google result and the step in hand. Everything else is ink and stone.

rules.name: The Status-Is-Wash Rule
rules.body: Status pills are pale washes with dark text of the same hue.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every figure in a table, KPI or total uses tabular numerals and right alignment.

dos: Do lead each screen with a noun title and one grey line stating the finding.
Do put the most frequent job one click away, in the title row.
Do print zeros as 0, missing values as a grey dash, and label demo data.
donts: Don't use a dark sidebar, welcome banner, icons in circles, sparklines or gradient charts.
Don't show placeholder payment details or invented proof to owners.
Don't fill a column of row buttons in black, or nest a card in a card.
